context_checks: French et al. official arXiv abstract supports injection/post-injection stages, guide-field/system-size dependence and parallel/Fermi/pickup mechanisms cited in the introduction.
Zenitani et al. official arXiv abstract supports the Lorentz-invariant electron-frame diagnostic description.
Pezzi et al. official arXiv abstract and Yang et al. publisher-deposited Crossref abstract support distinguishing electromagnetic work, pressure-strain and dissipation proxies.
Bird et al. official arXiv abstract supports the general-purpose PIC framework/scaling description; the audit does not attribute the postprocessing issue to the VPIC particle pusher.
Fadeev is cited for historical configuration context; the audited force-free modification is checked directly against the pinned preprint and example input decks.
limits: This metadata/citation review is not a fresh full-text scientific audit of all cited predecessor articles.
